reddit.title: Introducing Ranks That Turn and March in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update for Provincia that enhances how our soldiers move and engage in battles. With the new mechanics, formations will now drag and face the direction you pull, ensuring a more realistic movement. No more teleporting units or awkward overlaps during attacks. Check out the details of this update here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

posts: Check out our latest update on how ranks will now turn and march in Provincia! This change improves formation movement and attack mechanics. Learn more: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

We're refining how units operate in Provincia! Discover how soldiers will now slide into formation and attack without teleporting. Full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

steam.title: New Update: Ranks That Turn and March
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major update to Provincia that redefines how our soldiers move and engage in battle. With new formation mechanics, units will now slide into position without teleporting or overlapping. This change aims to create a more immersive and realistic experience. For more information, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
